summary: The b64decode filter decodes Base64 to a string; binary data would be corrupted, so decode binaries with the base64 command via shell stdin instead.
questions: How do I decode a Base64 string in Ansible?
Why is my decoded binary file corrupted with b64decode?
How do I decode a Base64 binary blob to a file?

answer_card.title: b64decode filter and binary data
answer_card.answer_md:
`b64decode` returns a **string**, so decoding binary data with it will likely corrupt it. For binary blobs, pipe through the `base64` command, e.g. with `ansible.builtin.shell`:

```yaml
- ansible.builtin.shell:
    cmd: base64 --decode > myfile.bin
    stdin: "{{ encoded }}"
```
